correctness.rationale: Independently classified ordered pairs of edges as identical, incident, or vertex-disjoint with exact weights 1/(pq), (p+q-2)/(pq), (p-1)(q-1)/(pq). Their shortest continuous paths have the laws |U-V|, U+V (or 2-U-V), and 2-|U-V|. Mixture gives both piecewise density branches with no atoms, mean 5/3-2(p+q)/(3pq), and f(0+)=2/(pq), yielding sum/product p+q,pq and hence precisely unordered part sizes including stars and K_{1,1}. The nonlimiting mixture weight (p+q-1)/(pq) proves TV bound. Independently checked rational identities over 676 pairs, including asymmetric and star boundaries; finite check is not the universal proof.
